comparison.objective: Cleans an SC ferrule and latches the connector into an adapter; candidate finishes thread inserts by removing tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Cleaner actuation and keyed connector insertion/latching differ from hammer-and-mandrel fracture control and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Ferrule must be cleaned and connector latched; candidate requires four fractures, four recovered tangs, no remaining or escaped fragment, and no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: The connector task tests cleaning and insertion/latching, not destructive finishing of retained inserts.
